rules.why: Every card must be neutral or from your Master's faction
Advanced play: bring exactly 3 Districts (or none for the core-set City)

do.prompt: Panic: where does a Citizen flee?
Old Hollow: move a Lurker into the striker's district?
Awaken the Old One: which district?
Sequel: where does the Killer return?
Mandrake Patch: create a Mandrake where?
Frenzy: your Vampire must attack. Clash which unit?
The Wicker Colossus: burn it now?
Vanish: stay or slip to an adjacent district
Place the next District of the City
Mulligan: choose any cards to shuffle back (once)

req.why: A Quiet Word cancels a card as it is played
